description: This file defines the ResourceLoader class, which models the <resource-loader> element in the OFBiz service configuration. It encapsulates attributes such as className, name, prefix, and prependEnv, and validates these during instantiation.

classes.name: ResourceLoader
classes.description: An immutable final class representing the resource-loader element in the configuration, providing access to its attributes.

methods.name: ResourceLoader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ResourceLoader object by extracting and validating attributes from the provided XML Element.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with the resource loader.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the resource loader.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix attribute for the resource loader.

methods.name: getPrependEnv
methods.description: Returns the prepend environment variable string.
